key_provisions_or_claims: Develops radar-based ego-motion estimation evaluated on RadarScenes, simulation and real robot data
Proposes millimeter-wave radar SLAM for autonomous navigation
Includes a component on the ethics of AI in autonomous navigation
annotation.summary_en: University of Virginia Libra ETD record for a thesis on radar-based ego-motion estimation and millimeter-wave radar SLAM using RadarScenes, simulation and real robot data, with a title reference to the ethics of AI in autonomous navigation. Mostly a technical engineering work; only an excerpt is available.
annotation.title_clean: Radar-Based Ego-Motion Estimation Using RadarScenes, Simulation, and Real-World Robot Data; Ego-Motion Estimation via Millimeter-Wave Radar SLAM Reconstructing Perception: Radar SLAM and the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence in Autonomous Navigation
annotation.title_en: Radar-Based Ego-Motion Estimation Using RadarScenes, Simulation, and Real-World Robot Data; Ego-Motion Estimation via Millimeter-Wave Radar SLAM Reconstructing Perception: Radar SLAM and the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence in Autonomous Navigation
